content.description: Diagram showing hand operating a switch with directional arrows indicating movement

content.text: (g) Insure that the switch operates smoothly.
(h) Connect the terminals to the connector. (See pages BE-3 and 13)

content.description: Two relay wiring diagrams side by side - left showing 'No continuity' between terminals, right showing 'Continuity' between terminals. Both show relay coil symbol and three numbered terminals

items.heading: INSPECT RELAY CONTINUITY
subitems: (a) Check that there is continuity between terminals 1 and 2.
(b) Check that there is no continuity between terminals 2 and 3.
If continuity is not as specified, replace the relay.

items.heading: INSPECT RELAY OPERATION
subitems: (a) Apply battery voltage across terminals 1 and 2.
(b) Check that there is continuity between terminals 2 and 3.
If operation is not as specified, replace the relay.

content.description: Relay wiring diagram showing continuity test with battery applied, relay coil, and light bulb connected to terminals 2 and 3
Relay wiring diagram showing six-terminal relay with two coils and two sets of switch contacts. Left side labeled 'No continuity', right side labeled 'Continuity'. Terminals numbered 1-6

items.heading: INSPECT RELAY CONTINUITY
subitems: (a) Check that there is continuity between terminals 1 and 2 and also between terminals 4 and 5.
(b) Check that there is continuity between terminals 4 and 6.
(c) Check that there is no continuity between terminals 3 and 4.
If continuity is not as specified, replace the relay.
